description:
A modern SVN client built with Tauri, Vue 3, and TypeScript

OrcaSVN is a modern SVN workbench that provides a graphical interface for managing Subversion repositories. Built with Tauri for native performance, Vue 3 for the frontend, and TypeScript for type safety. Features include workspace management, commit, update, diff, blame, log viewing, and more.
What's new since v0.6.1
Improvements
- Unify light/dark colors, typography, controls, file status badges, and scrollbars
- Simplify the toolbar and improve responsive navigation, welcome screens, and theme selection
- Support keyboard operation and accessible labels for workspace filters and file selection
- Reduce page margins to 6px and panel corner radii to 8px
Fixes
- Prevent repository names and revisions from being vertically clipped; truncate long values and show full text on hover
- Distinguish an empty workspace from a filter with no matching files
- Disable developer tools, deny Tauri's internal toggle command, and block inspection shortcuts while preserving editing shortcuts
自 v0.6.1 以来的更新
功能改进
- 统一浅色/深色主题、字体、控件、文件状态徽标与滚动条样式
- 精简顶部工具栏，优化响应式导航、欢迎页面和主题选择
- 工作区筛选与文件选择支持键盘操作，补充无障碍标签
- 页面外边距缩小至 6px，面板圆角缩小至 8px
问题修复
- 修复顶部仓库名和版本文字下沿裁切；超长内容省略显示，悬停可查看完整内容
- 区分工作区没有改动与筛选结果为空的提示
- 禁用开发者工具及 Tauri 内部切换命令，拦截调试快捷键并保留常用编辑快捷键
